left.headlineHtml:
You don't need
to be ready to sell
to reach out.
left.intro: Whether you're years away from a decision, just curious about the market, or ready to move now — I'm happy to have an honest conversation. No pressure. No pitch.
left.note:
Tyler Gerding · Principal Broker · Multifamily Advisor
Licensed in Oregon · Gerding Commercial Real Estate
gerdingcre.com

form.title: Send a message
interestOptions: I'm thinking about selling a property
form.disclaimer: I typically respond within one business day. No pressure — this is just a conversation.

reassurance.title: No obligation
reassurance.body: Reaching out doesn't mean you're committing to anything. Most of my best client relationships started with a simple question years before any transaction.

reassurance.title: Honest advice
reassurance.body: If the market isn't right for you right now, I'll tell you. I'd rather be the advisor you trust for years than the broker who pushes a deal that isn't in your interest.

reassurance.title: Real experience
reassurance.body: Fifteen years in Portland multifamily. Over a decade as an owner myself. I bring genuine perspective to every conversation — not a sales script.
